_comment: Route criteria and clocks. A criterion or clock is used only if status is VERIFIED-REOPENED; otherwise the script prints a [CHECK] message and does not require it. Texts are the recorded passages (fragments or local-text quotes); see references/method-standards.md for how each was read. Sources R2 and R3 are DRAFT guidances: routes that use them must set draft_basis_acknowledged. Grounding lane (7 November 2026): every criterion and clock carries passage_ids that resolve in references/verbatim-passages.json.

clock.basis: of receipt, as worded in R1 for standard review

criteria.text: The application is for a drug that treats a serious condition
If approved, the drug would provide a significant improvement in safety or effectiveness

clock.basis: FDA's goal is to take action on the marketing application within 6 months of receipt (compared with 10 months under standard review). The review clock for applications filed under the PDUFA Program is described in section IV of R1, which was not extracted: [CHECK] for new molecular entities.

criteria.text: Intended for the treatment of a serious or life-threatening disease or condition
Demonstrates the potential to address unmet medical needs for such a disease or condition
Intended, alone or in combination, to treat a serious or life-threatening disease or condition
Preliminary clinical evidence indicates the drug may demonstrate substantial improvement over existing therapies on 1 or more clinically significant endpoints
Product for a serious or life-threatening disease or condition

Effect on a surrogate endpoint reasonably likely to predict clinical benefit, or on a clinical endpoint measurable earlier than irreversible morbidity or mortality that is reasonably likely to predict an effect on it or other clinical benefit

Confirmatory trial plan: FDA generally intends to require that the confirmatory trial(s) be underway prior to the accelerated approval action (DRAFT guidance, January 2025; the 2014 final guidance says confirmatory trials 'should usually be already underway at the time of approval')

clock.basis: up to 210 days, not counting clock stops

criteria.text: The CHMP decides the product is of major interest for public health and therapeutic innovation
The applicant provides sufficient justification for an accelerated assessment

clock.basis: the CHMP can reduce the timeframe to 150 days (from up to 210, not counting clock stops)

criteria.text: Medicine under development that is not yet authorised in the EU
Targets a condition with an unmet medical need, with no treatment option or a major therapeutic advantage over existing treatments
Must demonstrate the potential to address an unmet medical need to a significant extent

eu_conditional_ma.label: Conditional marketing authorisation

criteria.text: The benefit-risk balance of the medicine is positive
It is likely that the applicant will be able to provide comprehensive data post-authorisation
The medicine fulfils an unmet medical need
The benefit of the medicine's immediate availability to patients is greater than the risk inherent in the fact that additional data are still required

eu_conditional_ma.validity: valid for one year and can be renewed annually (R8)

criteria.text: Any one of: the indications are encountered so rarely that the applicant cannot reasonably be expected to provide comprehensive evidence; or in the present state of scientific knowledge comprehensive information cannot be provided; or it would be contrary to generally accepted principles of medical ethics to collect such information
